title.en: Make Ten: Why Split the 5 in 8+5?

aha.zh: 为什么要"凑成 10"？

misconception.zh: 八加五只能从八开始一个一个往上数；把五拆开，就会少掉几个。
misconception.en: Eight plus five means counting up from eight one at a time; breaking the five apart loses some.

insight.zh: 把五拆成两个和三个，先填满一个十，十三就一眼看得出来，一个也没少。
insight.en: Split the five into two and three, fill up a ten first, and thirteen shows at a glance, with nothing lost.

non_example.zh: 三加四加起来不到十，十格框装不满，凑十帮不上忙，直接数就好。
non_example.en: Three plus four is less than ten and doesn't fill the frame, so making ten doesn't help; just count.

stem.zh: 九加四等于几？
stem.en: What is nine plus four?

stem.zh: 算八加五，为什么要从五里拆出两个？
stem.en: In eight plus five, why take two out of the five?

en: Eight and two more make exactly ten
Because five is smaller than eight
Because two is easiest to count

stem.zh: 十格框里有七个点，还差几个就满了？
stem.en: A ten frame has seven dots. How many more to fill it?

stem.zh: 把五拆成两个和三个，一共还是五个吗？
stem.en: If you split five into two and three, is it still five?
Example: 9+4=9+1+3=10+3. Four splits into one and what?
Fill in: 7+6=7+3+□=10+□. What goes in the box?

stem.zh: 用凑十算六加八，等于几？
stem.en: Make ten to work out six plus eight. What is it?

stem.zh: 九加七等于几？先凑十想一想。
stem.en: What is nine plus seven? Make ten first.

stem.zh: 算六加七，先凑十，要从七里拆出几个？
stem.en: For six plus seven, how many do you take from the seven to make ten?

stem.zh: 二加三要不要凑十？
stem.en: Does two plus three need making ten?

en: Yes, all adding needs making ten

title.en: Egg-Carton Make Ten

zh: 一个装十个蛋的鸡蛋盒，或在纸上画一个两排、每排五格的十格框
二十颗豆子（两种颜色更好）
en: a ten-egg carton, or a ten frame drawn on paper (two rows of five boxes)
twenty beans (two colours if you have them)

zh: 在盒子里放九颗豆子，盒子外面放四颗。
请孩子从外面挪几颗进去，把盒子装满。
问：盒子满了是几？外面还剩几？一共是几？
换成七加六、八加七，再做一遍。
en: Put nine beans in the carton and four beside it.
Ask your child to move some beans in until the carton is full.
Ask: how many is a full carton? How many are left outside? How many altogether?
Try again with seven plus six and eight plus seven.

zh: 为什么要从外面那堆里拆？
换成六加三，还用凑十吗？
en: Why do we split the pile outside?
What about six plus three: do we still need to make ten?

safety.zh: 家里有三岁以下的弟弟妹妹，换成大一点的东西，比如瓶盖。
safety.en: If there's a child under three at home, use something bigger, like bottle caps.

next_hook.zh: 十格框是两排五个。换成五排两个，一样多吗？
next_hook.en: A ten frame is two rows of five. What about five rows of two: is that the same?

transcript.zh: 蛋盒里放了八个蛋，又拿来五个，一共几个？
transcript.en: There are eight eggs in the egg box, and here come five more. How many in all?

transcript.zh: 先别数，在心里估一估。
transcript.en: Don't count yet. Just make a guess in your head.

transcript.zh: 弟弟要从八开始，一个一个往上数。
transcript.en: Little brother wants to start at eight and count up one at a time.

transcript.zh: 妹妹担心，把五拆开，会少掉几个。
transcript.en: Little sister worries that breaking the five apart will lose a few.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。这是十格框，两排，每排五格。
transcript.en: Let's look together. This is a ten frame: two rows, five boxes in each.

transcript.zh: 框里放了八个圆点，框外面还有五个。
transcript.en: Eight dots are inside the frame, and five more are outside.

transcript.zh: 从八往上数，九、十、十一、十二、十三。
transcript.en: Counting up from eight: nine, ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen.

transcript.zh: 数对了，可是要数五下，数多了容易乱。
transcript.en: That's right, but it takes five counts, and it's easy to slip.

transcript.zh: 换个办法。五个里面跳几个过去，框就满了？
transcript.en: Let's try another way. How many of the five should jump in to fill the frame?

transcript.zh: 跳两个过去，十格框正好装满，一格不空。
transcript.en: Two jump in, and the frame is full. Not one empty box.

transcript.zh: 装满的十格框，就是一个十，不用再一个个数。
transcript.en: A full ten frame is one ten. No need to count each one.

transcript.zh: 五拆成了两个和三个，合起来还是五个。
transcript.en: The five became two and three. Put together, it's still five.

transcript.zh: 一个十，再加三个，一眼就能看出是十三。
transcript.en: One ten and three more. You can see thirteen at a glance.

transcript.zh: 那三加四呢？三个加四个，框还没装满。
transcript.en: What about three plus four? Three and four don't fill the frame.

transcript.zh: 不到十，凑十就帮不上忙，直接数就好。
transcript.en: It's less than ten, so making ten doesn't help. Just count.

transcript.zh: 写成算式，八加五，和十加三一样多。
transcript.en: As a number sentence, eight plus five is the same as ten plus three.

transcript.zh: 等号的意思不是算出来，是两边一样多。
transcript.en: The equals sign doesn't mean work it out. It means both sides are the same.

transcript.zh: 在数轴上，从八跳两格到十，再跳三格到十三。
transcript.en: On the number line, hop two from eight to ten, then three more to thirteen.

transcript.zh: 看完和大人一起，用豆子摆一摆，自己凑个十。
transcript.en: After watching, grab some beans with a grown-up and make your own ten.

transcript.zh: 十格框是两排五个。换成五排两个，一样多吗？
transcript.en: A ten frame is two rows of five. What about five rows of two: is that the same?

title.en: Is 3×4 the Same as 4×3?

aha.zh: 换了顺序，为什么结果不变？

misconception.zh: 三个四和四个三是两回事，所以不一定一样多。
misconception.en: Three fours and four threes are different things, so they might not be the same amount.

insight.zh: 把点阵整个转一下，三排四个就成了四排三个，点一个没多、一个没少，所以三乘四等于四乘三。
insight.en: Turn the whole dot array and three rows of four become four rows of three, with not one dot gained or lost, so three times four equals four times three.

non_example.zh: 减法不能换顺序：五个拿走两个剩三个，两个要拿走五个根本不够拿。
non_example.en: Subtraction can't swap: five take away two leaves three, but two take away five isn't possible.

stem.zh: 两排六个和六排两个，哪个多？
stem.en: Two rows of six or six rows of two: which has more?

stem.zh: 点阵转过来，为什么点数不变？
stem.en: Why doesn't the number of dots change when we turn the array?

en: No dot was added or taken away

stem.zh: 五排，每排两个点，这是几个几？
stem.en: Five rows with two dots in each. How many of what?

stem.zh: 五减二和二减五一样吗？
stem.en: Are five minus two and two minus five the same?

zh: 不一样，二个不够拿走五个
en: No, two isn't enough to take five away

stem.en: Example: 3×4=4+4+4. 4×3=3+3+3+□. What goes in the box?
Fill in: 2×6=6×□

stem.zh: 七乘三，等于几乘七？
stem.en: Seven times three equals what times seven?

stem.zh: 五乘六和六乘五一样大吗？
stem.en: Are five times six and six times five the same?
Fill in: 2×9=9×□

stem.zh: 两排、每排八个，转过来是几排？
stem.en: Two rows of eight. After turning, how many rows?

title.en: Turn the Buttons

zh: 在纸上摆三排，每排四颗。
请孩子数一数一共几颗。
把整张纸转一下，再数一遍：现在是几排，每排几颗？
换成两排、每排六颗，再试一次。
en: Lay out three rows of four on the paper.
Ask your child to count them all.
Turn the whole sheet and count again: how many rows now, and how many in each?
Try again with two rows of six.

zh: 转了以后为什么还是一样多？
换成五排两个，还一样吗？
en: Why is it still the same after turning?
Does it work for five rows of two?

safety.zh: 家里有三岁以下的弟弟妹妹，换成大一点的东西，比如瓶盖。
safety.en: If there's a child under three at home, use something bigger, like bottle caps.

next_hook.zh: 下一集：九的口诀，为什么十位加一、个位减一？
next_hook.en: Next time: in the nines table, why do the tens go up by one and the ones go down by one?

transcript.zh: 排队时两排五个人，换成五排两个，人数变吗？
transcript.en: We line up in two rows of five, then switch to five rows of two. Does the number of kids change?

transcript.zh: 你先想一想，变还是不变？
transcript.en: Think about it first: does it change or not?

transcript.zh: 有同学嘀咕：两个五和五个二，是两回事。
transcript.en: One kid mutters: two fives and five twos are different things.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。把十格框整个转过来。
transcript.en: Let's look together. We turn the whole ten frame around.

transcript.zh: 变成五排两个，一个点也没多，一个也没少。
transcript.en: Now it's five rows of two: not one dot more, not one less.

transcript.zh: 再换一个点阵：三排，每排四个点。
transcript.en: Here's another dot array: three rows, four dots in each.

transcript.zh: 这是三个四：四加四加四，一共十二个。
transcript.en: That's three fours: four plus four plus four, twelve in all.

transcript.zh: 那四排三个呢？要重新摆一次，再数一遍吗？
transcript.en: What about four rows of three? Do we set it up and count all over again?

transcript.zh: 把这块点阵转过来，点会变多、变少，还是一样？
transcript.en: If we turn this array around, will there be more dots, fewer, or the same?

transcript.zh: 转一下，就成了四排，每排三个点。
transcript.en: Turn it, and it becomes four rows, three dots in each.

transcript.zh: 三加三加三加三，还是十二个，一个也不少。
transcript.en: Three plus three plus three plus three: still twelve, not one missing.

transcript.zh: 一个点没加，一个点没拿，只是换了一个方向。
transcript.en: Nothing added, nothing taken away. It just faces a new way.

transcript.zh: 三个四和四个三，原来是同一堆点。
transcript.en: Three fours and four threes are the very same dots.

transcript.zh: 可是减法就不行。五个拿走两个，剩三个。
transcript.en: But subtraction doesn't work like this. Five take away two leaves three.

transcript.zh: 两个要拿走五个，根本不够拿，顺序换不了。
transcript.en: Two take away five? There aren't enough. You can't swap the order.

transcript.zh: 写成算式，三乘四，就等于四乘三，都是十二。
transcript.en: As a number sentence, three times four equals four times three. Both are twelve.

transcript.zh: 排数是一个数，每排几个，是另一个数。
transcript.en: The number of rows is one number; how many in each row is the other.

transcript.zh: 换成六排七个也一样，转一转，个数不变。
transcript.en: Six rows of seven works too. Turn it, and the count stays the same.

transcript.zh: 看完和大人一起，用纽扣摆一摆，再转一转。
transcript.en: After watching, line up some buttons with a grown-up and turn them around.

transcript.zh: 下一集：九的口诀，为什么十位加一、个位减一？
transcript.en: Next time: in the nines table, why do the tens go up by one and the ones go down by one?

title.zh: 乘法口诀里藏着的"斜线"
title.en: The Hidden Diagonal in the Nines Table

aha.zh: 9 的口诀为什么十位加一、个位减一？

misconception.zh: 口诀没什么道理，只能死记硬背。
misconception.en: Times tables have no reason behind them; you just memorise them.

insight.zh: 九就是十少一：每多一排，多一个十、也多拿掉一个点，所以十位加一、个位减一。
insight.en: Nine is ten minus one: each extra row brings one more ten and takes away one more dot, so the tens go up by one and the ones go down by one.

non_example.zh: 八比十少二，个位每次少二，到八乘六就不够减了，规律断掉；十位加一、个位减一是九才有的。
non_example.en: Eight is ten minus two, so the ones drop by two each time and run out at eight times six; up one, down one belongs to nine alone.

stem.zh: 九乘三等于几？
stem.en: What is nine times three?

stem.zh: 九乘五，为什么十位是四？
stem.en: In nine times five, why are the tens four?

zh: 五个十拿掉五个，拆开一个十
en: Taking five from five tens breaks one ten

stem.zh: 七排，每排九个点，是九乘几？
stem.en: Seven rows of nine dots. Nine times what?

stem.zh: 八的口诀为什么没有加一减一的规律？
stem.en: Why don't the eights go up one and down one?

en: Eight is two less than ten, not one
The eights have no pattern at all

stem.en: Example: 9×3=10×3−3. 9×5=10×5−□. What goes in the box?

stem.zh: 用十减的办法算九乘八。
stem.en: Use the ten-minus trick to work out nine times eight.

stem.zh: 九乘七的十位是几？
stem.en: What is the tens digit of nine times seven?

stem.zh: 九乘九等于十乘九减几？
stem.en: Nine times nine is ten times nine minus what?

stem.zh: 九乘八，个位是几？
stem.en: What is the ones digit of nine times eight?

title.en: Nines on Ten Fingers

zh: 张开双手，十根手指从左数起。
算九乘三，就把左边数第三根手指弯下去。
弯下的手指左边有两根，是十位；右边有七根，是个位：二十七。
换九乘七、九乘八，再试一试。
en: Hold up both hands and count the ten fingers from the left.
For nine times three, bend down the third finger from the left.
Two fingers are left of it, the tens; seven are right of it, the ones: twenty-seven.
Try nine times seven and nine times eight.

zh: 为什么弯下的那根左边是十位？
en: Why are the fingers on the left the tens?
Does this work for the eights too?

next_hook.zh: 为什么九乘四拆成十乘四减四，不会算错？
next_hook.en: Why can nine times four be split into ten times four take away four without going wrong?

transcript.zh: 姐姐背到九的口诀，卡住了：这列数有规律吗？
transcript.en: Big sister got stuck on her nines table. Is there a pattern in this column?

transcript.zh: 你盯着这列数，先找一找。
transcript.en: Look hard at the column and hunt for it first.

transcript.zh: 姐姐叹气：口诀没道理，只能死记硬背。
transcript.en: She sighs: times tables make no sense, you just learn them by heart.

transcript.zh: 看这些数，十位一直加一，个位一直减一。
transcript.en: Look at these numbers: the tens go up by one, and the ones go down by one.

transcript.zh: 我们用圆点排一排，看看它为什么会这样。
transcript.en: Let's line up some dots and see why that happens.

transcript.zh: 每一排都补满十个，一排就是一个十。
transcript.en: Fill every row up to ten. Each row is one ten.

transcript.zh: 再把每排最后一个拿掉，一排就剩九个。
transcript.en: Now take the last dot off every row. Each row has nine left.

transcript.zh: 九乘一，一排，一个十少一个，是九。
transcript.en: Nine times one: one row, one ten minus one. That's nine.

transcript.zh: 九乘二，两排，两个十少两个，是十八。
transcript.en: Nine times two: two rows, two tens minus two. That's eighteen.

transcript.zh: 每多一排，就多一个十，也多拿掉一个点。
transcript.en: Each extra row adds one more ten, and takes away one more dot.

transcript.zh: 九乘四呢？四排，你猜十位是几，个位是几？
transcript.en: Nine times four? Four rows. Can you guess the tens and the ones?

transcript.zh: 四个十里拿掉四个，就要拆开一个十。
transcript.en: Taking four from four tens means breaking open one ten.

transcript.zh: 剩下三个十，还有六个，就是三十六。
transcript.en: That leaves three tens and six more: thirty-six.

transcript.zh: 十位比排数少一，个位和排数合起来是十。
transcript.en: The tens are one less than the rows, and the ones plus the rows make ten.

transcript.zh: 八的口诀呢？八比十少二，每排拿掉两个。
transcript.en: What about the eights? Eight is two less than ten, so each row loses two.

transcript.zh: 个位每次少二，到八乘六，就不够减了。
transcript.en: The ones drop by two each time, and at eight times six they run out.

transcript.zh: 所以加一减一，是九才有的，因为九比十少一。
transcript.en: So up one, down one belongs to nine, because nine is one less than ten.

transcript.zh: 写成算式，九乘四，就等于十乘四减去四。
transcript.en: As a number sentence, nine times four is ten times four take away four.

transcript.zh: 看完和大人一起，张开十根手指，弯一弯试试。
transcript.en: After watching, hold up ten fingers with a grown-up and try bending one down.

transcript.zh: 为什么九乘四拆成十乘四减四，不会算错？
transcript.en: Why can nine times four be split into ten times four take away four without going wrong?

title.en: The Distributive Law Is Just One Cut

aha.zh: (a+b)×c 为什么等于 a×c+b×c？

misconception.zh: 五加三再乘四，就是五加上三乘四，得十七（只乘了一项）。
misconception.en: Five plus three, times four, is five plus three times four, which is seventeen (only one part gets multiplied).

insight.zh: 四排八格的长方形沿五和三中间切一刀，两块加起来还是整块，所以五加三的和乘四，等于五乘四加三乘四。
insight.en: Cut a rectangle of four rows of eight between the five and the three, and the two pieces still make the whole, so five plus three, times four, equals five times four plus three times four.

non_example.zh: 五乘三加四不能拆成五加四再乘三：五乘三是一块，四个格子是散的，拼不成一块长方形。
non_example.en: Five times three plus four can't become five plus four, times three: five times three is one block and the four squares are loose, so they don't make one rectangle.

stem.zh: 先算六加二，再乘三，等于几？
stem.en: Add six and two, then times three. What is it?

stem.zh: 长方形切一刀，两块加起来为什么不变？
stem.en: Why don't the two pieces of a cut rectangle add up to a different amount?

zh: 格子一个没多，一个没少
en: No square was added or lost

stem.zh: 四排七格切成三格和四格，左块几格？
stem.en: Four rows of seven, cut into three and four. How many squares on the left?

stem.zh: 二加五再乘三，能算成二加五乘三吗？
stem.en: Is two plus five, times three, the same as two plus five times three?

en: No, only one part got multiplied

stem.zh: 把十二拆成十加二，算十二乘七。
stem.en: Split twelve into ten and two to work out twelve times seven.

stem.zh: 十加一的和乘八，等于几？
stem.en: Ten plus one, times eight. What is it?

stem.zh: 六乘九，等于六乘十减几？
stem.en: Six times nine is six times ten minus what?
Can 2×7+6 become (2+6)×7?

en: No, the six is loose squares

title.en: One Cut on Squared Paper

zh: 在方格纸上画一个四格高、八格宽的长方形，剪下来。
沿一条竖线剪一刀，分成两块，各数各的，再加起来。
en: Draw a rectangle four squares tall and eight wide on squared paper, and cut it out.
Cut along one vertical line into two pieces, count each, then add them.
Cut somewhere else and count again.

zh: 为什么剪开以后加起来还是一样多？
en: Why do the pieces still add up to the same?
Does it work for six squares wide?

safety.zh: 大人帮忙剪，或者用儿童安全剪刀。
safety.en: A grown-up does the cutting, or use child-safe scissors.

next_hook.zh: 为什么二十三乘十四的竖式，要错一位？
next_hook.en: Twenty-three times fourteen: why does long multiplication shift the second row over?

transcript.zh: 每盒五支铅笔三支彩笔，四盒一共几支？
transcript.en: Each box has five pencils and three crayons. How many in four boxes?

transcript.zh: 你先算一算，把得数记在心里。
transcript.en: Work it out first and keep your answer in your head.

transcript.zh: 哥哥列成五加三乘四，算出十七。
transcript.en: Big brother writes five plus three times four, and gets seventeen.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。把每个点放进一个小方格。
transcript.en: Let's look together. Put every dot into its own little square.

transcript.zh: 点阵就变成一块长方形，一格一个。
transcript.en: The dot array turns into a rectangle, one dot per square.

transcript.zh: 换成四排，每排八格，八就是五加三。
transcript.en: Now make it four rows of eight squares. Eight is five plus three.

transcript.zh: 来找十七：右边三乘四，是十二格。
transcript.en: Where's the seventeen? The right part, three times four, is twelve squares.

transcript.zh: 再加五个单独的格子，左边一大片没算。
transcript.en: Plus five loose squares. The big part on the left got left out.

transcript.zh: 十七太少了，这个长方形明明有好多格。
transcript.en: Seventeen is far too few. This rectangle clearly has lots of squares.

transcript.zh: 沿五和三中间切一刀，两块加起来会变吗？
transcript.en: Cut it between the five and the three. Will the two pieces add up to something different?

transcript.zh: 切开分一分，左边是五乘四，有二十格。
transcript.en: Cut and pull apart: the left is five times four, twenty squares.

transcript.zh: 右边三乘四，是十二格，合起来三十二格。

title.zh: 分数除法为什么"颠倒相乘"

aha.zh: 除以 2/3 为什么等于乘 3/2？

misconception.zh: 除法一定让数变小；（或者）只记住了一个例子。

insight.zh: 除以 2/3 就是数「里面有几个 2/3」：每个 1 里面正好有 3/2 个，所以 6 里面有 6 × 3/2 = 9 个。
insight.en: Dividing by 2/3 asks how many 2/3s fit inside: every 1 holds exactly 3/2 of them, so 6 holds 6 × 3/2 = 9.

non_example.zh: 除以大于 1 的数，结果变小：6 ÷ 3/2 = 4，每个 1 里面只放得下 2/3 个 3/2。
non_example.en: Dividing by something bigger than 1 does make it smaller: 6 ÷ 3/2 = 4, because each 1 only holds 2/3 of a 3/2.

6 is six 1s; each 1 holds 3/2 of them, so 6 × 3/2 in total

title.zh: 比例：放大镜下形状不变
title.en: Ratios: Shapes That Survive the Magnifying Glass

aha.zh: 为什么"同时乘以同一个数"比值不变？

misconception.zh: 放大两倍，什么都跟着变两倍，面积也只变两倍；宽和高同时加上同一个数，形状也不变。
misconception.en: Scale by two and everything doubles, area included; and adding the same amount to width and height keeps the shape too.

insight.zh: 宽和高同时乘同一个数，宽是高的几倍就不变，比值不变，形状就不变；可面积是宽乘高，两条边各乘一次，放大两倍面积就是四倍。
insight.en: Multiply the width and the height by the same number and the width is still the same multiple of the height: the ratio, and so the shape, doesn't change. But area is width times height, so each side multiplies once; scale by two and the area goes up four times.

non_example.zh: 宽和高都加两格，三比二变成五比四，照片变方了；边长放大两倍，面积不是两倍，是四倍。
non_example.en: Add two squares to both the width and the height and 3 : 2 becomes 5 : 4, so the photo gets squarer; scale the sides by two and the area isn't doubled, it's four times as big.

title.en: Where Does the ½ in Triangle Area Come From?

misconception.zh: 除以二是规定的，背下来就行；钝角三角形的高在外面，公式就用不上了。
misconception.en: Dividing by two is just a rule to memorise; and when an obtuse triangle's height falls outside it, the formula no longer works.

insight.zh: 再拿一个一模一样的三角形，转半圈拼上去，就成了底乘高的平行四边形；一个三角形正好是它的一半，所以要除以二。
insight.en: Take an identical triangle, turn it half a turn and fit it on, and you get a parallelogram of base times height; one triangle is exactly half of it, which is why we divide by two.

non_example.zh: 把钝角三角形的斜边当成高去乘，算出来就大了；真正的高在三角形外面，两个钝角三角形照样拼成平行四边形，照样是一半。
non_example.en: Using an obtuse triangle's slanted side as the height gives too much; the real height lies outside the triangle, and two obtuse triangles still make a parallelogram, so it's still half.

aha.zh: πr² 是怎么来的？

misconception.zh: 圆是弯的，没法像长方形那样算面积；切成六十四块就真的变成长方形了。
misconception.en: A circle is curved, so it can't be worked out like a rectangle; and cutting it into sixty-four pieces turns it into an actual rectangle.

insight.zh: 把圆切成很多小扇形交错拼起来，越切越细就越接近一个长方形：高是半径 r，长是半个圆周派 r，所以面积是派 r 方。
insight.en: Cut a circle into many thin wedges and fit them together top-to-tail, and the finer the cut, the closer it gets to a rectangle: its height is the radius r and its length is half the circumference, pi r, so the area is pi r squared.

aha.zh: 为什么是 1/3？

misconception.zh: 圆锥是圆柱的一半；倒沙子倒三次正好满，就算证明了。

transcript.zh: 现在两张现金、两张欠条，一张抵一张，余额是零。
transcript.en: Two notes of cash, two IOUs, they cancel out: the balance is zero.

transcript.zh: 乘法还是几个几：前面的数管放进还是拿走，后面的数管现金还是欠条。
transcript.en: Multiplication is still 'so many lots of': the first number says put in or take away, the second says cash or IOU.

transcript.zh: 二乘三，放进两份三元现金，余额多了六元。
transcript.en: Two times three: put in two lots of three yuan cash. The balance goes up by six.

transcript.zh: 二乘负三，放进两张欠条，余额少了六元。
transcript.en: Two times negative three: put in two IOUs. The balance goes down by six.

transcript.zh: 负二乘三，拿走两份现金，余额也少了六元。
transcript.en: Negative two times three: take away two lots of cash. The balance also goes down by six.

transcript.zh: 那负二乘负三，拿走两张欠条，余额会怎样？
transcript.en: So negative two times negative three: take away two IOUs. What happens to the balance?

transcript.zh: 把这两张欠条撕掉，欠别人的六元钱就没有了。
transcript.en: Tear up the two IOUs, and the money you owed is gone.

transcript.zh: 余额反而涨了六元，所以负二乘负三是正六。
transcript.en: The balance actually goes up by six, so negative two times negative three is positive six.

transcript.zh: 拿走欠条和放进现金一样，都让你更有钱。
transcript.en: Taking away IOUs is just like putting in cash: either way you're richer.

transcript.zh: 欠条变少，就是你欠的钱变少，等于多了钱。
transcript.en: Fewer IOUs means you owe less, which is the same as having more.

transcript.zh: 加法可不一样。负二加负三，是先欠两元，再欠三元。
transcript.en: Adding is different. Negative two plus negative three means owing two, then owing three more.

transcript.zh: 一共欠了五元，余额是负五，两个负号并没有抵消。
transcript.en: Five owed in all, a balance of negative five. The two minus signs don't cancel.

transcript.zh: 所以负负得正，就是拿走欠条，余额往上涨。
transcript.en: So negative times negative is positive: take away IOUs and the balance goes up.

transcript.zh: 四行放在一起看，放进现金和拿走欠条，余额都往上涨。
transcript.en: Put the four lines together: putting in cash and taking away IOUs both raise the balance.

transcript.zh: 负负得正是一个约定，可只有这样约定，这笔账才算得平。
transcript.en: It is a convention, but it's the only one that makes the accounts balance.

title.zh: 减去一个负数为什么是加
title.en: Why Subtracting a Negative Means Adding

misconception.zh: 三减负二等于一：三减二是一，负号没什么用。
misconception.en: Three minus negative two is one: three minus two is one, and the minus sign doesn't matter.

insight.zh: 减法问的是两个数差多少，也就是在数轴上从减数走到被减数要走几格；负二在零的左边，从负二走到三要走五格，所以三减负二等于五。
insight.en: Subtraction asks how far apart two numbers are: how many steps on the number line from the number you subtract to the one you start with. Negative two is left of zero, so from negative two to three is five steps, and three minus negative two is five.

non_example.zh: 一其实是三加负二：从三往左走两格，到一；那是加一个负数，不是减一个负数。
non_example.en: One is really three plus negative two: from three, two steps to the left, landing on one. That's adding a negative, not subtracting one.

transcript.zh: 五减二，就是从二走到五，数一数，一共差三格。

transcript.zh: 走了几格，答案就是几，所以五减二等于三。

transcript.zh: 三减二，从二走到三，差一格；三减一，从一走到三，差两格。
transcript.en: Three minus two: from two to three, one step. Three minus one: from one to three, two steps.

transcript.zh: 三减零，从零走到三，差三格。减去的数越小，差得就越多。
transcript.en: Three minus zero: from zero to three, three steps. The smaller the number we subtract, the bigger the gap.

transcript.zh: 那三减负二，从负二走到三，要走几格？
transcript.en: So three minus negative two: from negative two to three, how many steps?

transcript.zh: 从负二出发先走两格到零，再走三格才到三。
transcript.en: Start at negative two: two steps to reach zero, then three more to reach three.

transcript.zh: 我们一格一格数：一、二、三、四、五。
transcript.en: Let's count them one by one: one, two, three, four, five.

transcript.zh: 一共是五格，所以三减负二等于五。
transcript.en: Five steps in all, so three minus negative two is five.

transcript.zh: 负二在零的左边，离三更远，差距反而比三减零还大。
transcript.en: Negative two is left of zero, further from three, so the gap is even bigger than three minus zero.

transcript.zh: 那个一是从哪里来的？其实一是三加负二的答案。
transcript.en: So where did the one come from? One is actually the answer to three plus negative two.

transcript.zh: 加负二是从三往左走两格，停在一，问的是另一件事。
transcript.en: Adding negative two means two steps left from three, stopping at one. That's a different question.

transcript.zh: 所以减去负二，就是加上二：三减负二等于三加二。
transcript.en: So subtracting negative two is adding two: three minus negative two equals three plus two.

transcript.zh: 减法看的是差距，减数越往零的左边走，差距就越大。
transcript.en: Subtraction measures the gap: the further left of zero the number you subtract, the bigger the gap.

transcript.zh: 比如五减负一，就是从负一走到五，六格，等于五加一。
transcript.en: For example, five minus negative one is from negative one to five: six steps, the same as five plus one.

transcript.zh: 负号可不是没有用，它把起点挪到了零的另一边。
transcript.en: The minus sign isn't useless: it moves the starting point to the other side of zero.

insight.en: Cut a square with side a plus b once across and once down: you get a squared, b squared and two a-by-b strips, so a plus b squared is a squared plus two a b plus b squared.

non_example.zh: 大正方形里只放 a 方和 b 方两块，另外两个角上还空着两条长条，填不满；三加二的平方是二十五，三方加二方只有十三。
non_example.en: Put only a squared and b squared into the big square and two strips in the other corners stay empty; three plus two squared is twenty-five, but three squared plus two squared is only thirteen.

transcript.en: Settle on an answer before you read on.

transcript.zh: 表弟张口就答：平方就各自平方，a 方加 b 方。
transcript.en: Your cousin answers straight away: squaring squares each part, a squared plus b squared.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。平方就是正方形，这个正方形的边长是 a 加 b。
transcript.en: Let's look together. A square number is a square, and this square has side a plus b.

transcript.zh: 上边、左边都分成 a、b 两段，它的面积就是 a 加 b 的平方。
transcript.en: The top and left sides each split into a and b, and its area is a plus b, squared.

transcript.zh: 要是它等于 a 方加 b 方，正方形里就只有这两块。
transcript.en: If it equalled a squared plus b squared, the square would hold just these two pieces.

transcript.zh: 可是另外两个角上还空着两块，正方形根本没填满。

transcript.zh: 代个数试试，a 是三，b 是二，五的平方是二十五。
transcript.en: Try numbers: a is three and b is two, so five squared is twenty-five.

transcript.zh: 三的平方加二的平方只有十三，差了整整十二。
transcript.en: Three squared plus two squared is only thirteen, a whole twelve short.

transcript.zh: 空着的这两块，各是什么形状、有多大？

transcript.zh: 左下这块，长是 a，宽是 b，它的面积是 a 乘 b。
transcript.en: The bottom-left piece is a long and b wide, so its area is a times b.

transcript.zh: 右上这块也是 a 乘 b，两块一模一样。
transcript.en: The top-right piece is a times b too. The two are exactly the same.

transcript.zh: 所以多出来的是两个 a b，也就是二 a b。
transcript.en: So the extra part is two a b's: two a b.

transcript.zh: 差的这十二正好是两个三乘二，就是这两条长条。
transcript.en: The missing twelve is exactly two lots of three times two: these two strips.

transcript.zh: 所以 a 加 b 的平方，等于 a 方加二 a b 加 b 方。
transcript.en: So a plus b squared equals a squared plus two a b plus b squared.

transcript.zh: 这块是 a 方，这两条是二 a b，那块是 b 方。

transcript.zh: 平方不是各自平方，中间那两条长条，一条也不能丢。

aha.zh: a²−b² 为什么等于 (a+b)(a−b)？

non_example.zh: a 减 b 的平方只是 L 形里左下角那个正方形，旁边还多出两条长条；五方减二方是二十一，三的平方只有九。
non_example.en: a minus b squared is only the square in the bottom-left of the L, with two strips left over; five squared minus two squared is twenty-one, but three squared is only nine.

title.en: Solving an Equation Is Balancing a Scale

aha.zh: 两边同时减去同一个数，为什么还成立？

misconception.zh: 等号后面是写答案的地方，所以三加四等于空格加五，空格里填七。
misconception.en: The equals sign means 'write the answer here', so in 3 + 4 = blank + 5 the blank is 7.

insight.zh: 等号说的是两边一样重，像一架平着的天平；两边同时拿走一样多，天平还是平的，所以两边可以同时减去同一个数，一直减到盒子单独留在一边。
insight.en: The equals sign says both sides weigh the same, like a level balance. Take the same amount off both sides and it stays level, so you may subtract the same number from both sides until the box is left alone.

non_example.zh: 只从一边拿走砝码，天平马上歪向另一边，两边不一样重，等式就不成立了。
non_example.en: Take weights off only one side and the balance tips straight away: the sides no longer weigh the same, and the equation is no longer true.

transcript.zh: 空格里该填几？你先在心里填一个。

transcript.zh: 表弟填的是七，他觉得等号后面就是写答案的地方。

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。把等号想成一架天平，两边必须一样重。
transcript.en: Think of the equals sign as a balance: both sides must weigh the same.

transcript.zh: 左盘放三块再放四块，一共七块；右盘放一个盒子和五块。
transcript.en: On the left pan, three blocks and then four, seven in all. On the right, a box and five blocks.

transcript.zh: 等式成立，就是说七块和盒子加五块一样重，天平是平的。
transcript.en: The equation being true means seven blocks weigh the same as the box plus five: the balance is level.

transcript.zh: 要是盒子里是七，右盘就是七加五，十二块那么重。
transcript.en: If the box were seven, the right pan would be seven plus five: twelve blocks' worth.

transcript.zh: 十二比七重多了，天平一下子就歪了，所以七不对。
transcript.en: Twelve is much heavier than seven. The balance tips at once, so seven is wrong.

transcript.zh: 两边同时拿走五块，天平还会是平的吗？

transcript.zh: 两边各拿走五块，一次拿一块，左边右边一起拿。

transcript.zh: 天平还是平的，左边剩下两块，右边只剩下盒子。
transcript.en: The balance is still level. Two blocks are left on the left; only the box on the right.

transcript.zh: 左边是三加四减五，右边是空格加五减五，两边还是相等。
transcript.en: The left is three plus four minus five, the right is blank plus five minus five, and they're still equal.

transcript.zh: 盒子和两块一样重，所以空格里是二。
transcript.en: The box weighs the same as two blocks, so the blank is two.

transcript.zh: 要是只从一边拿呢？我们只从左边拿走两块。

transcript.zh: 天平马上歪向右边，两边不一样重，等式就不成立了。

transcript.zh: 把两块放回去，天平又平了。
transcript.en: Put the two blocks back, and it's level again.

transcript.zh: 所以等号说的是两边一样重，两边同时减去一样多，它还成立。
transcript.en: So the equals sign says both sides weigh the same; subtract the same from both, and it still holds.

transcript.zh: 换成字母也一样，x 加五等于七，两边都减五，x 就等于二。
transcript.en: Same with a letter: x plus five equals seven; subtract five from both sides, and x is two.

transcript.zh: 等号的意思不是写答案，而是两边一样重。
transcript.en: The equals sign isn't where the answer goes. It says: both sides weigh the same.

title.en: Why √2 Is Not a Fraction

aha.zh: 有没有一个分数平方后正好等于 2？

misconception.zh: 分数可以无限接近根号二，差不多就是分数了。
misconception.en: Fractions can get as close to root two as you like, so it's basically a fraction.

insight.zh: 假设根号二等于 a 比 b（b 最小），就有一个直角边 b、斜边 a 的等腰直角三角形，三边都是整数；把一条直角边沿角平分线折到斜边上，切出一个直角边 a−b、斜边 2b−a 的小等腰直角三角形，边长还是整数而且更小，和"最小"矛盾。
insight.en: Suppose root two is a over b, with b as small as possible. Then there is an isosceles right triangle with legs b and hypotenuse a, all whole numbers. Fold one leg onto the hypotenuse along the angle bisector: it cuts off a smaller isosceles right triangle with legs a − b and hypotenuse 2b − a. Those are again whole numbers, and smaller, contradicting "smallest".

non_example.zh: 七比五很接近：七的平方是四十九，五的平方的两倍是五十，差一，就不是相等；越接近的分数也只是差得更少，从来不是零。
non_example.en: Seven fifths is close: seven squared is forty-nine, twice five squared is fifty. Off by one is not equal; closer fractions are only off by less, never by zero.

stem.zh: 1.4² 和 1.42² 哪个更接近 2？有没有一个分数的平方正好是 2？
stem.en: Which is closer to 2: 1.4² or 1.42²? Is there a fraction whose square is exactly 2?

en: 1.4² is closer; yes, it's just hard to find

stem.zh: 折过去以后，斜边上剩下的那段为什么是 a − b？
stem.en: After the fold, why is the leftover piece of the hypotenuse a − b?

zh: 折过去的直角边长 b，占了斜边的 b，斜边一共长 a
en: The folded leg is b long and covers b of the hypotenuse, which is a long
Because the fold is an angle bisector

stem.zh: 为什么 a − b 和 2b − a 都是正数，而且 a − b 比 b 小？
stem.en: Why are a − b and 2b − a positive, and a − b smaller than b?

zh: 因为 a/b 在 1 和 2 之间：b < a < 2b
因为它们是小三角形的边
en: Because a/b is between 1 and 2: b < a < 2b
Because they are the small triangle's sides

stem.en: Example: 7² = 49 and 2×5² = 50, off by 1. How far apart are 17² and 2×12²?

stem.zh: 如果斜边 a = 17、直角边 b = 12，折一次后小三角形的直角边和斜边是多少？
stem.en: If the hypotenuse is a = 17 and the legs are b = 12, what are the small triangle's legs and hypotenuse after one fold?

stem.zh: 41/29 的平方比 2 大还是小？
stem.en: Is (41/29)² bigger or smaller than 2?

stem.zh: √2 = 1.41421356… 的小数会不会从某一位开始循环？
stem.en: Does √2 = 1.41421356… start repeating at some digit?

zh: 不会：循环小数都能写成分数
不知道，要算下去才知道
en: Yes, the repeating block is just very long
No: every repeating decimal is a fraction
Can't tell without computing more digits

next_hook.en: So when root two is written as a decimal, could it start repeating at some point?

transcript.zh: 边长为一的正方形纸，沿对角线对折，折痕长根号二。
transcript.en: A square sheet of paper with side one: fold it along the diagonal. The crease is root two long.

transcript.zh: 先别急，心里站个队：它能正好写成一个分数吗？
transcript.en: Don't rush; pick a side in your head: can it be written exactly as a fraction?

transcript.zh: 同桌拿尺子一量，一点四一四，说量得再细点，总能凑出一个分数。
transcript.en: Your deskmate measures it with a ruler, gets one point four one four, and says: measure finely enough and some fraction will fit.

transcript.zh: 我们先假设，根号二等于 a 比 b，a 和 b 都是正整数。
transcript.en: First suppose root two equals a over b, with a and b whole numbers.

transcript.zh: 这样的分数要是有，就取分母 b 最小的那一个。
transcript.en: If such fractions exist, take the one whose denominator b is smallest.

transcript.zh: 两边平方，a 方等于 b 方加 b 方。
transcript.en: Square both sides: a squared equals b squared plus b squared.

transcript.zh: 按勾股定理，这就是一个等腰直角三角形，两条直角边是 b，斜边是 a。
transcript.en: By Pythagoras, that's an isosceles right triangle: both legs b, hypotenuse a.

transcript.zh: 沿着上面这个角的平分线折一下，让左边的直角边贴到斜边上。
transcript.en: Fold along the bisector of the top angle, so the left leg lies flat on the hypotenuse.

transcript.zh: 折过去的这条边长 b，斜边长 a，所以斜边上还剩一段 a 减 b。
transcript.en: The folded leg is b long and the hypotenuse is a, so a piece a minus b is left over.

transcript.zh: 原来的直角落在了斜边上，所以右下角切出了一个小三角形。
transcript.en: The right angle now sits on the hypotenuse, and it cuts off a small triangle in the bottom right.

transcript.zh: 这个小三角形，边长还是整数吗？
transcript.en: Are this small triangle's sides still whole numbers?

transcript.zh: 它的右下角也是四十五度，所以两条直角边一样长，都是 a 减 b。
transcript.en: Its bottom-right angle is also forty-five degrees, so its two legs are equal: both a minus b.

transcript.zh: 底边左边那段折上去就是这条边，也是 a 减 b，剩下的斜边是二 b 减 a。
transcript.en: The left part of the bottom edge folded up into that leg, so it's a minus b too, and the rest, the small hypotenuse, is two b minus a.

transcript.zh: 再看大小：一小于根号二小于二，所以 b 小于 a 小于二 b。
transcript.en: Now sizes: one is less than root two, which is less than two, so b is less than a, which is less than two b.

transcript.zh: 于是 a 减 b 和二 b 减 a 都是正整数，而且 a 减 b 比 b 小。
transcript.en: So a minus b and two b minus a are both positive whole numbers, and a minus b is smaller than b.

transcript.zh: 又是一个整数边的等腰直角三角形，直角边却比 b 还小，这就矛盾了。
transcript.en: Again an isosceles right triangle with whole-number sides, but with legs shorter than b. That's a contradiction.

transcript.zh: 在小三角形里还能再折一次，一个比一个小，正整数却不能一直变小。
transcript.en: We can fold the small one again, smaller and smaller, but whole numbers can't keep shrinking.

transcript.zh: 那七比五呢？七的平方四十九，五的平方的两倍是五十。
transcript.en: What about seven fifths? Seven squared is forty-nine; twice five squared is fifty.

transcript.zh: 差一点就不是相等，再接近的分数，也只是差得更少。
transcript.en: Off by a bit is not equal; closer fractions are only off by less.

transcript.zh: 所以根号二不能写成分数，它是一个无理数。
transcript.en: So root two can't be written as a fraction. It is an irrational number.

transcript.zh: 这是一个证明，只用到了折纸，和正整数不能一直变小。
transcript.en: This is a proof, using only a fold and the fact that whole numbers can't shrink forever.

transcript.zh: 那根号二写成小数，会不会从某一位开始循环？
transcript.en: So when root two is written as a decimal, could it start repeating at some point?

title.zh: 勾股定理：拼一拼就看见
title.en: The Pythagorean Theorem: Rearrange and See

aha.zh: 为什么是 a²+b²=c²，而不是 a+b=c？

misconception.zh: 斜边就等于两条直角边加起来，c 等于 a 加 b。
misconception.en: The long side is just the two short sides added up: c equals a plus b.

insight.zh: 同一个大正方形里，四个直角三角形只换个摆法，空白处就从 c 方变成 a 方加 b 方，所以 a 方加 b 方等于 c 方。
insight.en: In the same big square, just rearrange the four right triangles and the empty space turns from c squared into a squared plus b squared, so a squared plus b squared equals c squared.

non_example.zh: 把直角撑成钝角，四个三角形戳出大正方形、互相压住，拼不起来；这时 c 方比 a 方加 b 方大。
non_example.en: Push the right angle open into an obtuse one and the triangles poke out of the square and overlap, so nothing fits; then c squared is bigger than a squared plus b squared.

transcript.zh: 斜边 c 是最长的一条，比 a 长，也比 b 长。

transcript.zh: 如果 c 等于 a 加 b，斜边就和两条直角边接起来一样长。

transcript.zh: 大正方形不动，把三角形两两拼成长方形，空白会变成什么？

transcript.zh: 大正方形没变，三角形也没变，空白的面积就不会变。
transcript.en: The big square didn't change and the triangles didn't change, so the empty area can't change either.

transcript.zh: 要是不是直角呢？把直角撑开，看看会怎样？

title.en: Slope: How Steep Is a Line?

aha.zh: y=kx+b 里的 k 到底是什么？

misconception.zh: k 是直线和 x 轴的交点，或者是直线的长度。
misconception.en: k is where the line crosses the x-axis, or how long the line is.

insight.zh: y 等于 k x 加 b 里的 k 是一个比：沿直线横走一格，竖走 k 格；小三角形滑到哪儿、放大多少倍，竖走除以横走都是 k，它管的是直线有多陡、往哪边斜。
insight.en: In y equals k x plus b, k is a ratio: step one unit across along the line and you go k units up. Slide the little triangle anywhere or scale it, and rise over run is always k. It says how steep the line is and which way it tilts.

non_example.zh: k 保持二不变只改 b，直线上下平移，和 x 轴的交点一直在变，小三角形却一点没变，所以 k 不是交点。
non_example.en: Keep k at two and change only b: the line slides up and down, its x-intercept keeps moving, yet the little triangle doesn't change at all. So k is not the intercept.

transcript.en: Make k minus one: now you go one unit down, and the line tilts downward.

transcript.zh: k 等于零，竖着不用走，直线是水平的。
transcript.en: At k equals zero, you don't go up at all: the line is flat.

transcript.zh: 那 k 是不是直线和 x 轴的交点呢？
transcript.en: So is k where the line crosses the x-axis?

transcript.zh: k 一直等于二，只改 b 的话，整条直线往下平移，和 x 轴交点的位置一直在变。
transcript.en: Keep k at two and change only b. The whole line slides down, and the crossing point keeps moving.

transcript.zh: 但是小三角形没有变化，横走一格还是竖走两格。
transcript.en: But the little triangle doesn't change: still one across, two up.

transcript.zh: 交点变了，k 没变，所以 k 不是交点，和直线画多长也无关。
transcript.en: The crossing point changed and k didn't, so k isn't the intercept, and it has nothing to do with how long the line is drawn.

transcript.zh: 还记得放大照片吗？宽和高同时乘二，比值不变。
transcript.en: Remember enlarging a photo? Multiply width and height both by two, and the ratio stays the same.

transcript.zh: 横走两格，竖走四格；横走半格，竖走一格，比值都是二。
transcript.en: Two across, four up. Half across, one up. The ratio is two every time.

transcript.zh: 因为 x 多走一段，y 就多走 k 倍这么长。
transcript.en: Because whenever x moves some distance, y moves k times that distance.

transcript.zh: 所以 k 就是竖着走的格数除以横着走的格数，这个比，叫做斜率。
transcript.en: So k is rise divided by run. That ratio is called the slope.

transcript.zh: k 不是交点，也不是长度，它是一个比，管直线有多陡。
transcript.en: k isn't the intercept or the length. It's a ratio, and it tells you how steep the line is.

transcript.zh: 下次换成抛物线，它最低的那个点藏在式子的哪里？
transcript.en: Next: for a parabola, where in the formula is its lowest point hiding?

title.zh: 配方：把矩形补成正方形
title.en: Completing the Square, Literally

aha.zh: 求根公式是从哪里来的？

misconception.zh: 求根公式只能死记硬背；补的角块是 b 方。
misconception.en: The quadratic formula can only be memorised; the corner you add is b squared.

insight.zh: x 方加 b x 的面积图，把长条对半分、一半挪到上面，就只差一个边长二分之 b 的角；补上它就是正方形，开个方就解出 x，求根公式就是这样推出来的。
insight.en: In the area picture of x squared plus b x, split the strip in half and move one half to the top: only a corner with side b over two is missing. Fill it and you have a square, take the square root and you have x. That's where the quadratic formula comes from.

non_example.zh: 角上补 b 方：b 方是四乘四，角上只空着二乘二，大了四倍，塞不进去；整条长条不分开，补一个 b 方也还缺一条 b x。
non_example.en: Adding b squared to the corner: b squared is four by four but the gap is only two by two, four times too big. Without splitting the strip, adding b squared still leaves a b x strip missing.

stem.zh: x² + 4x = 45，x 是多少（x 大于 0）？
stem.en: x² + 4x = 45. What is x (x greater than 0)?

stem.zh: x² + bx 配方时，角上补的是多大？
stem.en: When completing the square for x² + bx, what goes in the corner?

stem.zh: 为什么要把 bx 的长条对半分？
stem.en: Why split the bx strip in half?

zh: 两边各贴一条，才能围成缺一个角的正方形
en: One half on each side makes a square with one corner missing

stem.zh: x² + 4x = 45 还有一个负数解，是多少？
stem.en: x² + 4x = 45 also has a negative solution. What is it?

stem.zh: 看例子：x² + 4x + 4 = (x + 2)²。x² + 10x 加几能配成完全平方？
stem.en: Example: x² + 4x + 4 = (x + 2)². What do you add to x² + 10x to make a perfect square?

stem.zh: 解 x² + 6x = 16（x 大于 0）。
stem.en: Solve x² + 6x = 16 (x greater than 0).

stem.zh: 解 x² + 8x = 20（x 大于 0）。
stem.en: Solve x² + 8x = 20 (x greater than 0).

stem.zh: x² + 12x 加几能配成完全平方？
stem.en: What do you add to x² + 12x to make a perfect square?

stem.zh: 解 x² + 2x = 24（x 大于 0）。
stem.en: Solve x² + 2x = 24 (x greater than 0).

stem.zh: x² + 6x + 9 和 (x + 3)² 哪个大？
stem.en: Which is bigger: x² + 6x + 9 or (x + 3)²?

next_hook.zh: x 方加六 x 等于十六，你会在角上补多大一块？
next_hook.en: x squared plus six x equals sixteen. How big a corner would you add?

transcript.zh: 一千多年前，花拉子米的书里就有这样一道题。
transcript.en: Over a thousand years ago, al-Khwarizmi's book already had a problem like this.

transcript.zh: x 方加四 x 等于四十五，要是没有公式，你从哪下手？
transcript.en: x squared plus four x equals forty-five. With no formula, where would you start?

transcript.zh: 同桌直摇头：这得背求根公式，套进去才算得出。
transcript.en: Your deskmate shakes their head: you need the quadratic formula, memorised and plugged in.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看图。这块 x 方是边长 x 的正方形，四 x 是宽四的长条。
transcript.en: Let's look together. x squared is a square with side x, and four x is a strip four wide.

transcript.zh: 要是能把整块补成正方形，开个方就解出来了。
transcript.en: If we could make the whole thing into a square, one square root would solve it.

transcript.zh: 先试试在角上补一个 b 方，看能不能补成正方形。
transcript.en: First try adding b squared in the corner and see if it makes a square.

transcript.zh: 可是边长 x 加 b 的正方形，左上角还空着一大块。
transcript.en: But a square with side x plus b still has a big empty piece at the top left.

transcript.zh: 上一集刚说过，它里面有两条长条，这里只有一条。
transcript.en: Remember from before: that square has two strips in it, and here there's only one.

transcript.zh: 把长条切成两半，一半挪到上面，缺的角有多大？
transcript.en: Cut the strip into two halves and move one half to the top. How big is the missing corner?

transcript.zh: 长条对半切开，每条宽二分之 b，这里是二。
transcript.en: Cut the strip in half. Each piece is b over two wide, which here is two.

transcript.zh: 右边一条转过来贴到上面，三块拼成一个缺角的正方形。
transcript.en: Turn the right-hand piece round and put it on top: three pieces make a square with a corner missing.

transcript.zh: 缺的角边长是二，面积是二分之 b 的平方，就是四。
transcript.en: The missing corner has side two, so its area is b over two, squared: four.

transcript.zh: 补上它，就是边长 x 加二的大正方形。
transcript.en: Fill it in, and we have a big square with side x plus two.

transcript.zh: 那角上补一个 b 方行不行？
transcript.en: So could we put b squared in the corner instead?

transcript.zh: b 方是四乘四，角上只空着二乘二，大了四倍，塞不进去。
transcript.en: b squared is four by four, but the gap is only two by two: four times too big. It doesn't fit.

transcript.zh: 所以 x 方加四 x 加四，等于 x 加二的平方。
transcript.en: So x squared plus four x plus four equals x plus two, squared.

transcript.zh: 方程两边都加四，x 加二的平方就是四十九。
transcript.en: Add four to both sides of the equation, and x plus two, squared, is forty-nine.

transcript.zh: 开个方，x 加二等于七，所以 x 等于五。
transcript.en: Take the square root: x plus two is seven, so x is five.

transcript.zh: x 加二也可以是负七，负九也是解，只是图上画不出来。
transcript.en: x plus two could also be minus seven, so minus nine is a solution too; the picture just can't show it.

transcript.zh: 四换成任意的 b，补的都是二分之 b 的平方，求根公式就是这么推出来的。
transcript.en: Swap four for any b and you always add b over two, squared. That's how the quadratic formula is derived.

transcript.zh: 还记得切一刀吗？配方也只是切开、挪一挪、补一块。
transcript.en: Remember cutting once? Completing the square is just cutting, moving, and filling one piece.

transcript.zh: x 方加六 x 等于十六，你会在角上补多大一块？
transcript.en: x squared plus six x equals sixteen. How big a corner would you add?

title.en: Where Is the Vertex of a Parabola?

aha.zh: y=a(x−h)²+k 为什么能看出顶点？

misconception.zh: 看到 x 减一，就说顶点在 x 等于负一。
misconception.en: Seeing x minus one, you say the vertex is at x equals minus one.

insight.zh: 平方不会是负数，最小是零；y 等于 a 乘 x 减 h 的平方加 k 里，括号等于零的地方就是顶点，x 等于 h，这时 y 等于 k；a 只管开口宽窄，不动顶点。
insight.en: A square is never negative; its smallest value is zero. In y equals a times x minus h squared plus k, the vertex is where the bracket is zero: x equals h, and there y equals k. The a only changes how wide it opens, not where the vertex is.

non_example.zh: y 等于 x 方减二 x 加三，式子里的负二和三都不是顶点；点二，三在曲线上，却在半山腰。配方成 x 减一的平方加二，才看出顶点是一，二。
non_example.en: In y equals x squared minus two x plus three, neither minus two nor three is the vertex. The point two, three is on the curve, but halfway up the side. Completing the square gives x minus one squared plus two, and the vertex one, two.

stem.zh: y = (x − 3)² 在 x 取多少时最小？
stem.en: For y = (x − 3)², which x gives the smallest y?

stem.zh: 为什么 y = (x − 1)² 的顶点横坐标是 1？
stem.en: Why is the vertex of y = (x − 1)² at x = 1?

zh: 因为 x = 1 时括号等于 0，平方最小
en: Because the formula has a 1 in it
Because at x = 1 the bracket is 0, and a square is smallest there

stem.zh: y = 2(x − 1)² + 2 和 y = (x − 1)² + 2，顶点一样吗？
stem.en: Do y = 2(x − 1)² + 2 and y = (x − 1)² + 2 have the same vertex?

stem.zh: 看例子：y = (x − 1)² + 2 的顶点是 (1, 2)。y = 3(x − 4)² − 5 的顶点是？
stem.en: Example: y = (x − 1)² + 2 has vertex (1, 2). What is the vertex of y = 3(x − 4)² − 5?

stem.zh: y = (x + 2)² + 1 的顶点是？
stem.en: What is the vertex of y = (x + 2)² + 1?

stem.zh: 把 y = x² − 6x + 10 配方，求顶点。
stem.en: Complete the square for y = x² − 6x + 10 and find the vertex.

stem.zh: y = −(x − 2)² + 5 的顶点是最高点还是最低点？为什么？
stem.en: Is the vertex of y = −(x − 2)² + 5 a highest or a lowest point? Why?

rubric.zh: 最高点 (2, 5)：−(x − 2)² ≤ 0，只在 x = 2 时等于 0，所以 y 最大是 5
rubric.en: Highest point (2, 5): −(x − 2)² ≤ 0 and is 0 only at x = 2, so the largest y is 5

next_hook.zh: 那为什么把 x 换成 x 加二，图像反而往左移？
next_hook.en: Then why does replacing x with x plus two move the graph to the left?

transcript.zh: 滑板场 U 形池的截面，像抛物线 y 等于 x 减一的平方。
transcript.en: The cross-section of a skate park's U-ramp looks like the parabola y equals x minus one, squared.

transcript.zh: 池底最低点，也就是顶点，在哪？
transcript.en: Where is the lowest point of the ramp, the vertex?

transcript.zh: 先别画图，在心里选一个点。
transcript.en: Don't draw it yet. Choose a point in your head.

transcript.zh: 朋友瞄了一眼减一，就说池底在 x 等于负一。
transcript.en: A friend glances at the minus one and says the bottom is at x equals minus one.

transcript.zh: 我们先代进去看看，x 等于负一时，括号里是负二，y 等于四。
transcript.en: Let's try it. At x equals minus one, the bracket is minus two, so y is four.

transcript.zh: 这可不是最低点，曲线在它右边还一路往下走，越走越低。
transcript.en: That's not the lowest point. The curve keeps going down to its right, lower and lower.

transcript.zh: 平方不会是负数，最小就是零，所以要括号里等于零才行。
transcript.en: A square is never negative. Its smallest value is zero, so we need the bracket to be zero.

transcript.zh: x 减一等于零，就是 x 等于一，顶点是横坐标一、纵坐标零。
transcript.en: x minus one equals zero means x equals one, so the vertex is at one, zero.

transcript.zh: 那在后面再加上二，顶点会跑到哪里去？
transcript.en: Now add two at the end. Where will the vertex go?

transcript.zh: 加二，就是每个 y 都多二，整条曲线往上抬两格。
transcript.en: Adding two raises every y by two, so the whole curve lifts up two units.

transcript.zh: 最低点还在括号等于零的地方，横坐标还是一，纵坐标变成二。
transcript.en: The lowest point is still where the bracket is zero: x is still one, and y is now two.

transcript.zh: 要是前面再乘二，每一点离顶点的高度都翻倍，曲线变窄。
transcript.en: And if we multiply by two in front, every point's height above the vertex doubles, and the curve gets narrower.

transcript.zh: 括号等于零的地方，乘二还是零，所以顶点不动。
transcript.en: Where the bracket is zero, times two is still zero, so the vertex stays put.

transcript.zh: 要是式子写成 x 方减二 x 加三，顶点在哪？
transcript.en: What if the formula is written as x squared minus two x plus three? Where is the vertex?

transcript.zh: 照数字去读，会以为横坐标二、纵坐标三，可那个点只在半山腰。
transcript.en: Reading off the numbers, you'd guess x is two and y is three. But that point is only halfway up the side.

transcript.zh: 还记得配方吗？它正是 x 减一的平方加二，顶点还是横坐标一、纵坐标二。
transcript.en: Remember completing the square? It's exactly x minus one squared plus two, so the vertex is still x one, y two.

transcript.zh: 所以 y 等于 a 乘 x 减 h 的平方加 k，顶点的坐标就是 h 和 k。
transcript.en: So for y equals a times x minus h squared plus k, the vertex is h, k.

transcript.zh: h 是让括号等于零的那个 x，k 是这时候的 y 值。
transcript.en: h is the x that makes the bracket zero, and k is the y at that moment.

transcript.zh: a 只管开口的宽窄，不会挪动顶点的位置。
transcript.en: The a only changes how wide it opens. It never moves the vertex.

transcript.zh: 看到减一，顶点却在正一，因为括号只有在那里才等于零。
transcript.en: See minus one, find the vertex at plus one: that's the only place the bracket is zero.

transcript.zh: 那为什么把 x 换成 x 加二，图像反而往左移？
transcript.en: Then why does replacing x with x plus two move the graph to the left?

title.zh: 相似三角形与三角函数
title.en: Similar Triangles and Trigonometry

aha.zh: 为什么 sin30° 永远是 1/2，跟三角形大小无关？

misconception.zh: 三角形画得越大，sin 三十度也越大。
misconception.en: The bigger you draw the triangle, the bigger sin 30° gets.

insight.zh: 三十度的直角三角形翻过来拼一个，正好是等边三角形，对边是这条边的一半，也就是斜边的一半；放大缩小只是同一个形状，所以 sin 三十度永远是二分之一。
insight.en: Flip a 30-degree right triangle over and put the two together and you get an equilateral triangle: the opposite side is half of one side, so half the hypotenuse. Enlarging or shrinking keeps the same shape, so sin 30° is always one half.

non_example.zh: 边长放大两倍，面积变成四倍；面积会跟着大小变，对边除以斜边这个比值不会。
non_example.en: Double the sides and the area becomes four times as big. Area changes with size; the ratio opposite over hypotenuse doesn't.

stem.zh: 一个 30° 直角三角形斜边 10，30° 角对的边多长？
stem.en: A 30° right triangle has hypotenuse 10. How long is the side opposite the 30° angle?

stem.zh: sin30° 为什么和三角形的大小无关？
stem.en: Why doesn't sin 30° depend on the size of the triangle?

zh: 对边和斜边按同一倍数变，比值不变
大的三角形 sin 更大
en: Opposite and hypotenuse scale together, so the ratio stays

stem.zh: 两个 30° 直角三角形沿邻边拼起来，是什么三角形？
stem.en: Two 30° right triangles put together along the adjacent side make what triangle?

stem.zh: 边长放大 3 倍，面积变几倍？
stem.en: Sides scaled by 3: how many times bigger is the area?

stem.zh: 看例子：斜边 10，30° 的对边 5。斜边 14 时对边是多少？
stem.en: Example: hypotenuse 10, side opposite 30° is 5. With hypotenuse 14, how long is it?

stem.zh: 30° 的对边是 6，斜边是多少？
stem.en: The side opposite 30° is 6. What is the hypotenuse?

stem.zh: 斜边 9，30° 的对边是多少？
stem.en: Hypotenuse 9: how long is the side opposite 30°?

stem.zh: 斜边 20，30° 的对边多长？
stem.en: Hypotenuse 20: how long is the side opposite 30°?

stem.zh: 一架梯子长 8 米，和地面成 30°，梯子顶端离地多高？
stem.en: An 8 m ladder makes 30° with the ground. How high is its top?

stem.zh: 斜边 3 和斜边 300 的 30° 直角三角形，哪个 sin30° 大？
stem.en: 30° right triangles with hypotenuse 3 and 300: which has the bigger sin 30°?

next_hook.zh: 那换成六十度，对边除以斜边又是多少？
next_hook.en: So what about sixty degrees: what's opposite over hypotenuse then?

transcript.zh: 两个同学各画了一个三十度的直角三角形，一小一大。
transcript.en: Two classmates each draw a thirty-degree right triangle, one small and one big.

transcript.zh: 大的那个，sin 三十度会变大吗？
transcript.en: For the big one, does sine of thirty degrees get bigger?

transcript.zh: 你站哪一边？先想想。
transcript.en: Whose side are you on? Think first.

transcript.zh: 画大的那位很得意，说自己的边更长，sin 肯定也更大。
transcript.en: The one with the big triangle is pleased, saying their sides are longer, so their sine must be bigger.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。sin 三十度，是对边除以斜边。
transcript.en: Let's look together. Sine of thirty degrees is the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse.

transcript.zh: 对边是三十度角对着的那条，斜边是最长的那条。
transcript.en: The opposite side faces the thirty-degree angle; the hypotenuse is the longest side.

transcript.zh: 把三角形放大到三倍，对边除以斜边会变吗？
transcript.en: Enlarge the triangle to three times the size. Does opposite over hypotenuse change?

transcript.zh: 放大，对边变长了，斜边也跟着一样变长。
transcript.en: Enlarge it: the opposite side grows, and the hypotenuse grows by the same factor.

transcript.zh: 缩小再放大，比值一直停在二分之一，一点不动。
transcript.en: Shrink it, enlarge it again: the ratio stays at one half and doesn't budge.

transcript.zh: 大小在变，形状没变，这些三角形都是相似的。
transcript.en: The size changes but the shape doesn't: these triangles are all similar.

transcript.zh: 为什么正好是二分之一？把三角形复制一个，沿着邻边翻过去。
transcript.en: Why exactly one half? Copy the triangle and flip it over the adjacent side.

transcript.zh: 三十度加三十度是六十度，三个角都是六十度的就是等边三角形。
transcript.en: Two thirty-degree angles make sixty. All three angles are sixty: it's an equilateral triangle.

transcript.zh: 竖着的这条边是对边的两倍，又和斜边一样长。
transcript.en: This vertical side is twice the opposite side, and it's as long as the hypotenuse.

transcript.zh: 所以对边正好是斜边的一半，不管三角形画多大。
transcript.en: So the opposite side is exactly half the hypotenuse, however big the triangle is.

transcript.zh: 可是面积就不一样了，我们再回到坐标系里看一看面积。
transcript.en: Area is a different story. Let's go back to the coordinate plane.

transcript.zh: 边长放大两倍时面积变成了四倍，面积跟着大小在变。
transcript.en: Double the sides and the area becomes four times as big. Area changes with size.

transcript.zh: 所以 sin 三十度永远是二分之一，和三角形的大小无关。
transcript.en: So sine of thirty degrees is always one half, whatever the size of the triangle.

transcript.zh: 它是一个比值，只看形状，不看大小，放大缩小都一样。
transcript.en: It's a ratio: it depends on shape, not size, and scaling never changes it.

transcript.zh: 三角形再大，sin 三十度也不会变大，它只和角度有关。
transcript.en: However big the triangle, sine of thirty degrees doesn't grow. It depends only on the angle.

transcript.zh: 那换成六十度，对边除以斜边又是多少？
transcript.en: So what about sixty degrees: what's opposite over hypotenuse then?

title.zh: 图像平移为什么是"左加右减"
title.en: Why f(x+2) Shifts Left

aha.zh: y=f(x+2) 为什么往左移？

misconception.zh: 加二就是往右移两格。
misconception.en: Plus two means shift right by two.

insight.zh: y 等于 f 括号 x 加二，在 x 处取到的是 f 在 x 加二处的值；原来要走到 a 才出现的值，现在走到 a 减二就出现了，每个值都提前两格，所以整条曲线左移两格。
insight.en: y equals f of x plus two takes, at x, the value f has at x plus two. A value that used to appear at a now appears at a minus two. Every value shows up two units early, so the whole curve shifts two units left.

non_example.zh: y 等于 f 括号 x，在外面再加二：加在外面改的是 y，曲线往上移两格，方向和符号一致；只有加在括号里才左右移。
non_example.en: y equals f of x, plus two outside: adding outside changes y, so the curve moves up two, the same way as the sign. Only adding inside the bracket moves it sideways.

stem.zh: f(x) = √x，f(4) = 2。g(x) = f(x + 2)，g 在 x 等于多少时等于 2？

transcript.zh: 那不从一开始呢？试试三、五、七、九、十一。

transcript.en: Eleven passes four blocks to three, nine passes two to five, and everything levels at seven.

transcript.zh: 七还是首尾的平均，和是五乘七，三十五。
transcript.en: Seven is still the average of first and last, and the sum is five times seven, thirty-five.

transcript.zh: 可要是一、二、四、八，每级多得不一样呢？
transcript.en: But what about one, two, four, eight, where the steps grow by different amounts?

transcript.zh: 首尾平均是四点五，可一共十五块，摊平只有三点七五。
transcript.en: The first-and-last average is four and a half, but there are fifteen blocks, so the level is only three and three quarters.

transcript.en: So an arithmetic series adds up to the number of terms times first plus last, divided by two.

transcript.zh: 两份台阶倒过来一拼，每排都是首项加末项，也是这个道理。

title.zh: 导数：把曲线放大到变成直线

aha.zh: 切线斜率为什么就是"瞬时变化率"？

misconception.zh: 切线就是只碰曲线一个点的直线；任何曲线放大都会变直。
misconception.en: A tangent is a line that touches the curve at just one point; and any curve turns straight if you zoom in far enough.

insight.zh: 切线是割线在 h 趋近于零时逼近的那条直线；把能求导的曲线在切点附近不断放大，弯曲越来越不明显，曲线越来越贴近这条切线。
insight.en: The tangent is the line the secants approach as h goes to zero. Zoom in on a differentiable curve near the point and the bend fades: the curve hugs that tangent more and more closely.

non_example.zh: y 等于 x 的绝对值在原点是尖角：放大多少倍都还是尖角，右边割线斜率总是一，左边总是负一，没有切线。
non_example.en: y equals the absolute value of x has a corner at the origin: zoom as far as you like and it stays a corner. Secants on the right always have slope one, on the left minus one, so there is no tangent.

stem.zh: 过抛物线上一点、只和抛物线碰一次的直线，都是切线吗？
stem.en: Is every line through a point of a parabola that meets it only once a tangent?

stem.zh: Q 滑向 P 时，割线的斜率在 y = x² 的 x = 1 处靠近几？
stem.en: As Q slides towards P, what does the secant slope of y = x² at x = 1 approach?

stem.zh: y = |x| 在原点为什么没有切线？
stem.en: Why does y = |x| have no tangent at the origin?

zh: 左右两边的割线逼近的不是同一条直线
因为直线 y = 0 和它碰了一个点
en: Secants from the left and right approach different lines
Because the line y = 0 touches it at one point
Because the value at the origin is 0

stem.zh: 看例子：y = x² 在 x = 1 处，割线斜率 = 2 + h，导数是 2。y = x² 在 x = 3 处，割线斜率化简是多少？

stem.zh: y = x² 在 x = 3 处的切线斜率是多少？
stem.en: What is the slope of the tangent to y = x² at x = 3?

stem.zh: y = 3x + 1 在任一点的切线斜率是多少？
stem.en: What is the slope of the tangent to y = 3x + 1 at any point?

stem.zh: y = x³ 在 x = 1 处的切线斜率是多少？

transcript.zh: 夜里骑车过弯，车灯照出去的那条直线，就是弯路在这一点的切线。
transcript.en: Riding a bike round a bend at night, the straight beam of your headlight is the tangent to the road at that point.

transcript.zh: 你会把这一点的切线画成哪一条直线？
transcript.en: Which line would you draw as the tangent at this point?

transcript.zh: 同伴随口一说：只碰曲线一个点的直线，就是切线。
transcript.en: Your friend says offhand: a line that touches the curve at just one point is the tangent.

transcript.zh: 可过 P 点的这条竖线也只碰一个点，却显然不是切线。
transcript.en: But this vertical line through P also touches just once, and it's clearly not a tangent.

transcript.zh: 换个问法：在 P 点附近，曲线到底有多陡？
transcript.en: Let's ask a different question: near P, how steep is the curve?

transcript.zh: 在曲线上再取一点 Q，连成割线，算它的斜率。
transcript.en: Take another point Q on the curve, join them with a secant, and find its slope.

transcript.zh: 两点横坐标相差 h，现在 h 等于一，斜率是三。
transcript.en: The two x-coordinates differ by h. Right now h is one, and the slope is three.

transcript.zh: 让 Q 沿着曲线一点一点滑向 P，斜率会靠近几？
transcript.en: Let Q slide along the curve towards P, bit by bit. What number does the slope approach?

transcript.zh: h 缩到零点五、零点一、零点零一，斜率越来越接近二。
transcript.en: Shrink h to a half, a tenth, a hundredth: the slope gets closer and closer to two.

transcript.zh: 从左边靠近也一样，斜率从一往上，也接近二。
transcript.en: From the left it's the same: the slope climbs up from one, towards two as well.

transcript.zh: 两边的割线逼近同一条直线，这就是 P 点的切线。
transcript.en: Both secants close in on the same line. That's the tangent at P.

transcript.zh: 再把 P 点附近放大十倍，弯曲已经不太明显。
transcript.en: Now zoom in ten times around P. The bend is already hard to see.

transcript.zh: 放大到六十倍，曲线和切线几乎贴在一起。

transcript.zh: 这是演示，不是证明：曲线始终是弯的，只是越来越像直线。
transcript.en: This is a demonstration, not a proof: the curve is still curved, it just looks more and more like a line.

transcript.zh: 那么，任何曲线放大，都会变直吗？
transcript.en: So does every curve turn straight if you zoom in?

transcript.zh: 看 y 等于 x 的绝对值，原点放大六十倍，还是尖角。
transcript.en: Take y equals the absolute value of x. Zoom sixty times at the origin: still a corner.

transcript.zh: 右边割线斜率总是一，左边总是负一，原点处没有切线。
transcript.en: Secants on the right always have slope one, on the left minus one. There's no tangent at the origin.

transcript.zh: 回到抛物线，把割线斜率化简，等于二加 h。
transcript.en: Back to the parabola. Simplify the secant slope and you get two plus h.

transcript.zh: h 趋近于零，二加 h 的极限是二，这就是 P 点的切线斜率。
transcript.en: As h goes to zero, two plus h tends to two: the slope of the tangent at P.

transcript.zh: 割线斜率在 h 趋近于零时的极限，叫做导数。
transcript.en: The limit of the secant slope as h goes to zero is called the derivative.

transcript.zh: 所以切线不是只碰一个点的直线，而是割线逼近的那条直线。
transcript.en: So a tangent isn't a line that touches once. It's the line the secants close in on.

transcript.zh: 换一个点，抛物线的切线斜率又是多少？
transcript.en: Next: at any other point, what's the slope of the parabola's tangent?

title.en: Why the Derivative of x² Is 2x

aha.zh: 求导公式能不能"看见"？

misconception.zh: 角上那一小块是硬丢掉的，所以二 x 只是个近似。
misconception.en: The little corner is just thrown away, so two x is only an approximation.

insight.zh: 边长 x 的正方形草坪往外长，就像右边、上边各有一把长 x 的滚筒刷往外推；刷过的就是新长的面积，所以面积每秒长二 x。两把刷子在角上补出的小方块，推得越短小得越快。
insight.en: A square lawn of side x growing outward is like two rollers, each x long, pushing out from the right and top edges. What they sweep is the new area, so the area grows at two x per second. The little square they leave at the corner shrinks much faster the shorter the push.

non_example.zh: 推得不短的时候角块丢不得：推出 x 那么远，角块和一条一样大。
non_example.en: When the push isn't short the corner can't be dropped: push out as far as x and the corner is as big as a strip.

stem.zh: 边长 10 的正方形，边长加 1，面积多出多少？
stem.en: A square of side 10 grows its side by 1. How much area is added?

stem.zh: 边长 x 加 dx，多出来的面积由哪几块组成？
stem.en: When the side x grows by dx, which pieces make up the added area?

zh: 两条 x·dx 的长条和一个 dx·dx 的角块
en: Two x·dx strips and one dx·dx corner

stem.zh: 两把滚筒刷推草坪，为什么角上那一小块可以不算？
stem.en: Two rollers push the lawn outward. Why can the little corner be left out?

zh: 因为除以 dx 后它是 dx，dx → 0 时趋于 0
en: Because it's too small to see
Because after dividing by dx it's just dx, which goes to 0

stem.zh: 看例子：(x²)′ = 2x，x = 1 时是 2。y = x² 在 x = 5 处的切线斜率是多少？
stem.en: Example: (x²)′ = 2x, which is 2 at x = 1. What is the tangent slope of y = x² at x = 5?

stem.zh: x = 3、dx = 0.1 时，(x+dx)² − x² 等于多少？
stem.en: With x = 3 and dx = 0.1, what is (x+dx)² − x²?

stem.zh: y = x² 在 x = −2 处的切线斜率是多少？
stem.en: What is the tangent slope of y = x² at x = −2?

stem.zh: 边长 x 的立方体每条边加 dx，多出来的体积里最大的是哪几块？一共约多少？
stem.en: Each edge of a cube of side x grows by dx. Which pieces of the added volume are biggest, and about how much do they add up to?

rubric.zh: 三块 x·x·dx 的薄板，约 3x²·dx（所以 (x³)′ = 3x²）
rubric.en: Three thin slabs of x·x·dx, about 3x²·dx (so (x³)′ = 3x²)

next_hook.zh: 如果边长只能取整数，d x 最小是一，角块还能丢吗？
next_hook.en: Next: if the side can only be a whole number, so dx is at least one, can we still drop the corner?

transcript.zh: 推导 x 平方的导数，最后一步，角上一小块被直接扔掉了。
transcript.en: When you work out the derivative of x squared, the last step simply throws away a little corner piece.

transcript.zh: 要是你来批改，这一步给不给分？
transcript.en: If you were marking it, would that step get the mark?

transcript.zh: 后排同学不服：扔掉一块还说相等，二 x 只能算近似值。
transcript.en: A classmate at the back objects: you threw a piece away and still call it equal, so two x is only an approximation.

transcript.zh: 上一集我们在一这个点算出斜率是二，这次换个看法。
transcript.en: Last time we found the slope at one is two. This time, a different view.

transcript.zh: x 的平方，就是一块边长为 x 的正方形草坪的面积。
transcript.en: x squared is the area of a square lawn with side x.

transcript.zh: 草坪的边每秒往外长一，面积每秒多出多少？
transcript.en: The lawn's edges move out by one every second. How much area does it gain per second?

transcript.zh: 想象两把滚筒刷推着边往外走，每秒能刷多少？
transcript.en: Picture two paint rollers pushing the edges outward. How much do they cover each second?

transcript.zh: 右边一把，上边一把，每把刷子都和边一样长，是 x。
transcript.en: One roller on the right, one on top, each exactly as long as the side: x.

transcript.zh: 刷子往外推，刷过的地方，就是新长出来的草坪。
transcript.en: Push the rollers out, and whatever they sweep is the new lawn.

transcript.zh: 边长三的时候，两把各刷三，每秒刷六。
transcript.en: When the side is three, each roller sweeps three: six per second.

transcript.zh: 边长五的时候，每把刷子长五，每秒刷十。
transcript.en: When the side is five, each sweeps five: ten per second.

transcript.zh: 两把刷子，每把长 x，所以每秒刷二 x。
transcript.en: Two rollers, each x long, so they cover two x per second.

transcript.zh: 那角上呢？两把刷子都没刷到，补出一个小方块。
transcript.en: And the corner? Neither roller sweeps it, so a little square fills the gap.

transcript.zh: 只推一小段 d x，它就是 d x 乘 d x，推得越短，小得越快。
transcript.en: Push only a little dx and it's dx by dx: the shorter the push, the faster it shrinks.

transcript.zh: 两条长条是 x 乘 d x，角块和它们一比，几乎没有。
transcript.en: The strips are x times dx; next to them the corner is almost nothing.

transcript.zh: 可要是一下推出 x 那么远，角块就和一条一样大，丢不得。
transcript.en: But push all the way out by x in one go and the corner is as big as a strip. You can't drop it.

transcript.zh: 所以面积长得有多快，就看两把刷子有多长，二 x。
transcript.en: So how fast the area grows is just how long the two rollers are: two x.

transcript.zh: 所以 x 平方的导数是二 x。
transcript.en: So the derivative of x squared is two x.

transcript.zh: 代 x 等于一，正好就是上一集算出的斜率二。
transcript.en: Put x equal to one and you get two, the slope we found last time.

transcript.zh: 角块不是硬丢的，而是它比长条小得越来越快。
transcript.en: The corner isn't thrown away: it just gets small much faster than the strips.

transcript.zh: 台阶一级一级地加，正方形一圈一圈地长，看的都是多出来的那块。
transcript.en: Staircases add step by step, squares grow ring by ring: either way, we look at the piece that's added.

transcript.zh: 如果边长只能取整数，d x 最小是一，角块还能丢吗？
transcript.en: Next: if the side can only be a whole number, so dx is at least one, can we still drop the corner?

title.en: Adding Vectors: Tip to Tail

aha.zh: 为什么平行四边形法则和三角形法则是同一回事？

misconception.zh: 和的长度等于长度的和：一支长四、一支长三，加起来长七。
misconception.en: The length of the sum is the sum of the lengths: one arrow is 4 long, the other 3, so together they are 7 long.

insight.zh: 向量只管长度和方向，平移到哪里都是同一个；向量 a 加向量 b 就是先走 a 再接着走 b，把 b 的尾巴接到 a 的头上，从起点指到终点的那支箭头就是和。两种顺序拼在一起围成平行四边形，所以平行四边形法则就是两次首尾相接。
insight.en: A vector only cares about its length and direction, so it is the same vector wherever you slide it. a plus b means walk a, then walk b: put the tail of b on the tip of a, and the arrow from the start to the end is the sum. The two orders together make a parallelogram, so the parallelogram rule is just tip-to-tail done twice.

non_example.zh: 只有两支箭头方向相同时长度才正好相加：向右三格再向右两格是五格；一拐弯，直着走过去就比七短，向右四格再向上三格只有五。
non_example.en: Lengths add only when the two arrows point the same way: 3 right then 2 right is 5. Once the path turns a corner, the straight line is shorter: 4 right then 3 up is only 5, not 7.

stem.zh: 向东走 4 米，再向北走 3 米，离出发点多远？
stem.en: Walk 4 m east, then 3 m north. How far are you from the start?

stem.zh: 为什么可以把 b 平移到 a 的头上再相加？
stem.en: Why are we allowed to slide b onto the tip of a before adding?

zh: 向量只管长度和方向，平移后还是同一个向量
平移会让 b 变长
只有从原点出发的箭头才能相加
en: A vector is only length and direction, so sliding it gives the same vector
Only arrows from the origin can be added

stem.zh: 平行四边形法则和三角形（首尾相接）法则是什么关系？
stem.en: How is the parallelogram rule related to the tip-to-tail (triangle) rule?

zh: 是两种不同的加法，结果不一样
平行四边形是两次首尾相接拼在一起，对角线就是和
平行四边形法则只在直角时成立
en: They are different additions with different answers
The parallelogram is two tip-to-tail paths side by side; its diagonal is the sum
The parallelogram rule only works for right angles

stem.zh: a + b 的长度什么时候正好等于 a 的长度加 b 的长度？
stem.en: When is the length of a + b exactly the length of a plus the length of b?

en: When a and b are perpendicular
When a and b point the same way

a + b = (5,2) and a = (2,3). What is b?

transcript.zh: 你从家出门，往东走四公里，再往北走三公里，现在离家多远？
transcript.en: You leave home, walk four kilometres east, then three kilometres north. How far are you from home now?

transcript.zh: 先别急着算，在心里估一估。
transcript.en: Don't work it out yet. Just estimate it in your head.

transcript.zh: 路一共走了七公里，离家好像也该是七公里。
transcript.en: You walked seven kilometres in all, so it seems you should be seven kilometres from home.

transcript.zh: 我们一起看。向量就是一支箭头，只管多长、朝哪边。
transcript.en: Let's look together. A vector is an arrow that only cares how long it is and which way it points.

transcript.zh: 向量 a 向右四格，向量 b 向上三格。
transcript.en: Vector a goes four squares right, vector b goes three squares up.

transcript.zh: 把箭头平移到别处，长度方向都没变，还是同一个向量。
transcript.en: Slide an arrow somewhere else: same length, same direction, still the same vector.

transcript.zh: a 加 b 的意思是：先走 a，再接着走 b。
transcript.en: a plus b means: walk along a, then carry on along b.

transcript.zh: 从起点直接指到终点，这一支就是 a 加 b。
transcript.en: The arrow straight from the start to the end is a plus b.

transcript.zh: 这支和的箭头有多长？真的是七吗？
transcript.en: How long is the sum arrow? Is it really seven?

transcript.zh: 三支箭头围成直角三角形，直角边是四和三。
transcript.en: The three arrows make a right triangle with legs four and three.

transcript.zh: 由勾股定理，斜边是五，不是七：拐弯走了冤枉路。

transcript.zh: 换两支斜着的箭头，a 是三、一，b 是一、二。
transcript.en: Now two slanted arrows: a is three, one and b is one, two.

transcript.zh: 先走 a 再走 b，把 b 接到 a 的头上。
transcript.en: Walk a, then b: put b on the tip of a.

transcript.zh: 先走 b 再走 a，终点还是同一个点。
transcript.en: Walk b, then a: you end at the very same point.

transcript.zh: 两条路围成平行四边形，对角线就是 a 加 b。
transcript.en: The two paths make a parallelogram, and its diagonal is a plus b.

transcript.zh: 所以平行四边形法则，就是两次首尾相接拼在一起。
transcript.en: So the parallelogram rule is just tip-to-tail done twice, side by side.

transcript.zh: 长度什么时候才能直接相加？方向相同的时候。
transcript.en: When do lengths simply add? When the arrows point the same way.

transcript.zh: 向右三格再向右两格，一共五格，路一点也不拐弯。
transcript.en: Three right, then two right: five in all, no corner at all.

transcript.zh: 在坐标里，首尾相接就是横的加横的、竖的加竖的。
transcript.en: In coordinates, tip-to-tail means across plus across, and up plus up.

transcript.zh: 三加一是四，一加二是三，正好指到四、三。
transcript.en: Three plus one is four, one plus two is three: it lands right on four, three.

transcript.zh: 和的长度不会超过长度的和，因为两点之间直着走最近。
transcript.en: The sum is never longer than the lengths added up, because straight is the shortest way between two points.
